schema: GEMSDOE parallel-run protocol run card v1

hypothesis.statement: Radiometric-hydrothermal + fluvial-channel-steepness (chi) + gravity-margin off-catalogue fault detector finds blind/pre-Quaternary faults absent from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue.
layers: GeoDAWN radiometric Th/K and eU/K alteration ratio
USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue (2 px collar only, to suppress detector-echo false positives)
hypothesis.physical_signature: Linear hydrothermal alteration (Th/K, eU/K) co-located with a gravity-margin edge and a fluvial-chi knickzone/uplift anomaly — blind range-front fault signature
hypothesis.why_off_catalogue: Catalogue maps only mapped/Quaternary surface faults; blind, low-relief, pre-Quaternary and hydrothermal-only faults are absent. Label-free except the 2 px collar.
hypothesis.differs_from_repo: Does NOT re-thin the H19-5 ridge skeleton (every focus-9 leader does). Radiometric-primary + fluvial-chi; related to GEMSDOE33 THKCOND but substitutes fluvial-chi + gravity margin for Th/K x conductivity.

mechanism: Hydrothermal fluids ascend along permeable fault zones leaving radiometric (Th/K, eU/K) and gravity-margin signatures; blind range-front uplift is recorded in fluvial chi anomaly. Combine layers into a propensity surface, apply a 2 px catalogue collar, emit ~37,654 dots via CELF-300 m constrained emission.
named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan pluvial wave-cut shorelines; intra-range bedrock cliff/talus breaks >18 deg; alluvial fan terrace risers; volcanic flow toes; differential compaction over buried paleovalleys.

holdout_dti.evaluator: dti_binary (Tversky alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel)
holdout_dti.holdout: hide whole fault segments + buffer, derive catalogue features only from visible faults, mask visible faults pixel-exactly
holdout_dti.note: No DrivenData auth -> labels.tif unavailable -> holdout DTI cannot be computed. self-test PASS on synthetic faults (perfect=1.0, none=0.0, far=0.0).
